slides.title: Day 1 · The map
slides.body: In February 2024, one ransomware attack on Change Healthcare exposed data on 192.7 million people. Change Healthcare, part of UnitedHealth Group, was hit by the BlackCat ransomware group in February 2024. UnitedHealth later confirmed that 192.7 million people were affected, nearly double its earlier estimate, making it the largest health data breach on record in the US. Former CEO Andrew Witty testified that the company paid a $22 million ransom and that the outdated systems involved lacked multifactor authentication.

slides.title: Actor 1 · Criminal gangs
slides.body: Ransomware gangs lock or steal data, then demand payment. Their motive is money. BlackCat, the group behind Change Healthcare, is one of them.

slides.title: Actor 2 · Nation-states
slides.body: Nation-state hackers seek access and leverage. Some quietly settle into critical infrastructure. US agencies said China-backed Volt Typhoon did this to prepare disruptive attacks. In February 2024, CISA and partner agencies warned that Volt Typhoon, a group sponsored by the People's Republic of China, was seeking to pre-position itself on IT networks for disruptive or destructive cyber activity against US critical infrastructure. It relied on living off the land: using tools already present on victims' systems to avoid detection.

slides.title: Actor 3 · Hacktivists
slides.body: Hacktivists attack to make a political point. Pro-Russia hacktivists have tampered with control systems at US and European water sites. A May 2024 fact sheet from CISA and partners described pro-Russia hacktivists targeting industrial control systems in North American and European water and wastewater systems, dams, energy, and food and agriculture. Their techniques were mostly unsophisticated and caused nuisance effects, but investigators warned they could pose physical threats to insecure systems.

slides.title: Speak in threat actors
slides.body: Security teams plan around who would attack them and why. Naming a company's likely attackers shows real understanding.

slides.title: The rule
slides.body: Know the attacker's motive, and you can predict the attack.

exercises.explanation: Motive predicts behavior: gangs want payment, states want quiet access, hacktivists want impact.
